stageNotes.title: Customer contacted
stageNotes.text: Customer contacted successfully. Concierge process explained and document collection started.

stageNotes.title: No answer
stageNotes.text: Attempted to contact the customer but received no response. Follow-up required.

stageNotes.title: Waiting for customer
stageNotes.text: Customer has been contacted and is expected to send the outstanding information.

stageNotes.title: Passport available
stageNotes.text: Customer confirmed that a passport is available. Awaiting passport data page.

stageNotes.title: Passport assistance needed
stageNotes.text: Customer does not currently have a passport and has been connected to Passport Assistance.

stageNotes.title: Passport received
stageNotes.text: Passport data page received and added to the customer document record.

stageNotes.title: NIN received
stageNotes.text: Customer NIN details received and recorded for document processing.

stageNotes.title: Documents incomplete
stageNotes.text: Some customer documents have been received, but additional documents are still outstanding.

stageNotes.title: Vaccination pending
stageNotes.text: Vaccination certificate is outstanding. Customer has been informed and operator assistance may be required.

stageNotes.title: Operator assistance required
stageNotes.text: Outstanding document support has been acknowledged for operator assistance after handoff.

stageNotes.title: Documents complete
stageNotes.text: Required customer documents have been collected or exceptions have been acknowledged.

stageNotes.title: Customer handed off
stageNotes.text: Customer has been handed off to the operator. Outstanding items and next steps were recorded.

followUps.title: Call customer
followUps.text: Call customer to discuss the booking and collect outstanding information.

followUps.title: WhatsApp follow-up
followUps.text: Send WhatsApp follow-up requesting the outstanding booking information.

followUps.title: Request passport
followUps.text: Follow up with customer for the passport data page.

followUps.title: Request NIN
followUps.text: Follow up with customer for NIN details.

followUps.title: Request vaccination
followUps.text: Follow up with customer for the vaccination certificate or confirm operator assistance.

followUps.title: Check customer response
followUps.text: Check whether the customer has responded and update the document checklist.

followUps.title: Follow up Passport Assistance
followUps.text: Follow up on the customer's Passport Assistance request and record the outcome.

followUps.title: Follow up operator
followUps.text: Follow up with the operator for the customer's document, payment, visa, or fulfilment update.

followUps.title: Payment reminder
followUps.text: Follow up with customer regarding the outstanding package payment.

followUps.title: Visa update request
followUps.text: Request the latest visa application update and supporting document from the operator.

followUps.title: Customer unavailable
followUps.text: Customer was unavailable. Try again on the next scheduled follow-up date.
